title.narrative: NCA 2022-2027: Suudu Baaba - inclusive peace in Mopti & Douentza
NORSKA KYRKAN 2022-2027: Suudi Baaba - inkluderande fred i Mopti & Douentza

description.narrative:
The consortium has formulated that the overall objective is "to contribute to peace and socioeconomic development in Djenné and Douentza.
Two specific sub-objectives are aligned to this goal. These are: 1. Communities strengthen social cohesion and find peaceful ways of managing natural resources and related conflicts 2. Communities improve their livelihoods by using and adapting a more efficient and sustainable use of natural resources in the face of climate change.
Insatsen utvecklar fredlig hantering av naturresurser i områdena Djenne och Douentza i kombination med försörjningsskapande åtgärder. Syftet är att minska konfliktnivån i samhället.

The contribution works with peaceful handling of natural resources in Djenne and Douentza in combination with income generating activities. The purpose is to reduce the conflict level in the areas.
The ultimate aim of the project "Suudu Baaba: inclusive peace and socio-economic resiliance in Mopti and Douentza" is to contribute to a community that is more socio-economic resilient and peaceful. The project will be executed for four years, starting October 2022 and is designed around two specific objectives: Specific objective 1: Communities strengthen social cohesion and inclusive natural resource and conflict management mechanisms and structures.Specific objective 2: Communities improve their livelihoods by adapting a more efficient and sustainable use of natural resources in the face of climate change.Norwegian Church Aid (NCA) is lead in a consortium that consists of the international NGO Cordaid and one Malian NGO called Tassaght and a Malian enterprise called Agricap. NCA is responsible for the funds and visavi the Embassy in terms of financial and narrative reporting. Funds will be transferred to other parties.
